body: SD:=Client.GetDocumentByPath('C:\Users\makarlistkov\Documents\Work\Engineering\FPGA-COURSE-WORK\ARTIX\ARTIX\libraries\TPS563210A\TPS563210A.SchLib'); L:=SchServer.GetSchDocumentByPath('C:\Users\makarlistkov\Documents\Work\Engineering\FPGA-COURSE-WORK\ARTIX\ARTIX\libraries\TPS563210A\TPS563210A.SchLib'); C:=L.CurrentSchComponent; if C.LibReference='TPS563210A' then begin LogStep('requested black text and Power pin types'); SchServer.ProcessControl.PreProcess(L,''); try C.OverideColors:=False; C.PinColor:=0; I:=C.SchIterator_Create; I.AddFilter_ObjectSet(MkSet(ePin)); P:=I.FirstSchObject; while P<>Nil do begin P.Color:=0; P.Electrical:=eElectricPower; P:=I.NextSchObject; end; C.SchIterator_Destroy(I); I:=C.SchIterator_Create; I.AddFilter_ObjectSet(MkSet(eLabel)); T:=I.FirstSchObject; while T<>Nil do begin T.Color:=0; if T.Text='DC/DC' then begin T.Location:=Point(6889764,-1181102); T.Justification:=eJustify_Center; end; T:=I.NextSchObject; end; C.SchIterator_Destroy(I); I:=C.SchIterator_Create; I.AddFilter_ObjectSet(MkSet(eParameter)); A:=I.FirstSchObject; while A<>Nil do begin A.Color:=0; A:=I.NextSchObject; end; C.SchIterator_Destroy(I); C.Designator.Color:=0; C.Comment.Color:=0; I:=C.SchIterator_Create; I.AddFilter_ObjectSet(MkSet(eRectangle)); R:=I.FirstSchObject; while R<>Nil do begin R.Color:=0; R:=I.NextSchObject; end; C.SchIterator_Destroy(I); LogStep('create two functional section dividers'); G:=SchServer.SchObjectFactory(eLine,eCreate_Default); G.OwnerPartId:=1; G.OwnerPartDisplayMode:=0; G.Location:=Point(4724409,0); G.Corner:=Point(4724409,-11811024); G.Color:=0; G.LineWidth:=eSmall; C.AddSchObject(G); G:=SchServer.SchObjectFactory(eLine,eCreate_Default); G.OwnerPartId:=1; G.OwnerPartDisplayMode:=0; G.Location:=Point(9055118,0); G.Corner:=Point(9055118,-11811024); G.Color:=0; G.LineWidth:=eSmall; C.AddSchObject(G); finally SchServer.ProcessControl.PostProcess(L,'Requested TPS GOST symbol appearance'); end; SD.SetModified(True); L.GraphicallyInvalidate; LogStep('save requested TPS edits'); if SD.DoFileSave('') then ResultText:='{"saved":true}' else ResultText:='{"error":"SAVE_FAILED"}'; end else ResultText:='{"error":"WRONG_COMPONENT"}';
